resources.string: Background location
Allow location access at all times only if background geofencing is needed. Android requires foreground location access first.
On Android 11 and above, choose Allow all the time from the app location permission settings.
Grant foreground location permission first, then return to background location.
Nearby Wi-Fi devices
Required for supported nearby Wi-Fi discovery and connections on Android 13+.
Microphone
Required for voice recording and speech actions.
Contacts
Access contact lists only for configured contact-related tasks.
Calendar
Read and add calendar entries for calendar automations.
Phone and calls
Phone status and call actions require different phone permissions. Android may restrict some operations.
Text messages (SMS)
Read, receive or send SMS. Some operations require default SMS app status or other Android restrictions.
Call history
Allows supported actions to read call history; device policy may restrict this permission.
Photos and videos
Android 14+ can grant access to selected photos instead of the whole library.
Physical activity
Needed for step count and physical activity detection.
Device administrator
Required for supported screen locking and device-administration actions; activate manually in system settings.
Grant permissions individually only as required by your automations. System settings may be necessary for special access; on return the status updates automatically.
If Accessibility cannot be enabled for a sideloaded APK, open Android App info, choose the menu and Allow restricted settings, then return to Accessibility. This option depends on the device.
Open app settings
Request permission / Open system settings
